title: Reconcile reserved release candidate and closeout report evidence
outOfScope: Creating, moving, or deleting any existing immutable tag
Publishing a release before the exact-source rehearsal succeeds
Rewriting WI-01 through WI-18 archived evidence
Changes to runtime/product behavior unrelated to release projections

sources.reason: WI-18 release candidate and lifecycle boundary.
Provider evidence that v0.5.61 is already immutable and must not be reused.
Canonical release progression and candidate rules.

riskAssessment.reason: A stale candidate projection must be reconciled to immutable provider evidence without reusing v0.5.61 or publishing a mismatched source.

reasons: Release identity and provider evidence require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized release completion; all provider mutations remain fail-closed behind exact evidence.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The provider v0.5.61 release and immutable tag are recorded as reserved evidence, and the source candidate advances exactly to v0.5.62 without deleting or moving v0.5.61.
release.json, release-state.json, next-release.json, install.sh, version.json, and release-digests.json pass all release consistency and readiness checks with provider evidence bound to v0.5.61.
The v0.5.62 exact-source rehearsal succeeds on the merged main SHA before any publication attempt; a failed rehearsal blocks publication and is recorded in the Summary.
The human-readable audit records the collision, evidence, resolution, remaining provider dependency, and no unsupported publication claim.
guidelines: Never reuse an immutable semantic-version tag.
Bind every release claim to provider evidence and the exact source commit.
Keep release projections and installer references synchronized atomically.
Do not claim publication until the provider release workflow supplies exact-source assets.

intent.problem: WI-18 attempted v0.5.61, but the provider already has an immutable v0.5.61 release while the repository candidate projection still names v0.5.61.
constraints: Do not reuse or move v0.5.61.
Use provider release assets as evidence, not local assumptions.
Advance exactly one patch to v0.5.62 and keep publication gated by exact-source rehearsal.
intent.rationale: Candidate truth must follow the highest immutable reserved version so release identity remains unambiguous and installer projections cannot target stale metadata.

declaredIntent.summary: Reconcile the reserved provider release into repository projections and prepare the next exact-source release candidate without reusing an immutable tag.

rawUserRequest: Complete the final release closeout; if the candidate is already reserved, reconcile it safely and continue with the next valid release.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized final release completion; exact provider evidence and immutable-tag rules remain mandatory.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The requested candidate tag already exists as an immutable provider release.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Publication of the reused tag is blocked and the tag is recorded as reserved evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect provider tag/release metadata and record the failed rehearsal receipt.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The local candidate is stale after the provider has reserved a higher patch.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: The candidate advances exactly one patch beyond v0.5.61 and projections remain mutually consistent.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the projection synchronizer and all release consistency/readiness checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The next candidate is prepared for publication.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: The exact-source rehearsal succeeds or publication remains blocked with its failure evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Dispatch release rehearsal against the freshly synchronized origin/main SHA.
